annotations.title: GDP per capita and GDP growth in EU countries (Eurostat)

description: Use for GDP per capita of EU countries, Poland against the EU in purchasing power, GDP growth of EU countries in a quarter, and when Poland could reach the EU average or another country. Tell the user that the catch-up year is arithmetic, not a forecast. GDP per capita of the 27 EU countries in purchasing power standards (PPS, EU27 = 100) and in EUR per inhabitant with the rank, real growth of GDP per capita (last year, 5- and 10-year averages), actual individual consumption per capita (AIC, EU27 = 100) and the price level of consumption, the latest quarter of real GDP growth (seasonally adjusted, quarter on quarter and year on year), the EU and the euro area, yearly history since 1995 of Poland, the EU and one country, and the finwire index finwire_eu_convergence_years (Licznik doganiania UE finwire): years until GDP per capita of Poland in PPS reaches the EU average at the average real growth of the last 10 years. Arithmetic on a constant pace, not a forecast.

country.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL), e.g. DE. Adds this country to the answer and the history. Default DE.
